status: Unweighted, automatic anti-alias and supplied-palette segmentation from prepared pixels implemented with size-penalty weight zero, including explicit native shadow dispatch. Constructor and broader shadow/control results match original recordings. Supplied plain-palette comparisons exclude recorded native precondition failures. Full image-file vectorization remains unfinished.

initial_regions.api: initializeRegions({ width, height, bgra, threshold }) returns an owned Int32Array of initial region labels.
initial_regions.input: Positive int32 dimensions with exactly width * height BGRA byte pixels. threshold is a finite nonnegative float32 value, matching Segmenter::lambda_pre.
initial_regions.precision: Normalize bytes with double(1/255), rather than the float32 conversion used by palette assignment. Accumulate channel sums and squared sums in double precision.
initial_regions.tiles: Visit 16 by 16 tiles in row-major order. Recursively visit top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right quadrants down to single pixels.
initial_regions.variance: For each nonempty tile, compute (sum(channelSquaredSums) - sum(channelSums squared) / pixelCount) / pixelCount with double arithmetic and left-to-right BGRA summation. Do not clamp small negative rounding results.
initial_regions.painting: When a tile exceeds the threshold, paint each child whose variance is at most the threshold. Otherwise paint the tile only when it is the top-level 16 by 16 tile. Recursive painting can be overwritten by a later parent paint.
initial_regions.labels: Start new labels at width * height. Increment the label counter for every paint call, including clipped-out child tiles. Do not compact or merge labels at this stage.
initial_regions.reference: Original 0x4aaac0, 0x4844a0, 0x481c60, 0x481130, and 0x47fd20 executed without instruction patches.
initial_regions.limits: This API performs initial tiling only. Connected rebuilding, merge/move passes, and diagonal-contact repair have separate APIs below. Automatic anti-alias processing has a separate integrated branch below.

color_merge_cost.api: regionColorMergeCost({ counts: [firstCount, secondCount], sums: [firstBgraSums, secondBgraSums] }) returns the float32 color-error increase for merging two nonempty regions.
color_merge_cost.input: Positive int32 pixel counts whose sum fits int32, and four finite float32 channel sums per region. Convert supplied sums to float32 once at the boundary.
color_merge_cost.arithmetic: Square each channel and sum in BGRA order, rounding every operation to float32. Divide each squared-sum total by the corresponding float32 count. Add those quotients, then subtract the squared norm of float32(firstSums + secondSums) divided by float32(firstCount + secondCount), with float32 rounding at each operation.
color_merge_cost.rounding: Preserve negative cancellation results; do not replace this computation with an algebraically equivalent mean-distance formula.
color_merge_cost.reference: Original 0x4aac30 using original 0x489660 statistics access. Explicit counts/sums supply harness-owned 28-byte statistic records.
color_merge_cost.limits: This is the color term. All ten recovered profiles use size-penalty weight zero. The separate nonzero size-penalty branch is not represented by this API.

diagonal_contacts.status: Independent diagonal-contact repair matches 994 original runs.
diagonal_contacts.api: Optimizer repairDiagonalContacts() edits its owned label map. Rebuild statistics explicitly after this stage, as the original branch does.
diagonal_contacts.scan: Visit each 2 by 2 square in row-major order, resolving union roots as it is read. Only opposite equal regions with no equal orthogonal pair are candidates.
diagonal_contacts.direction: When both diagonals are equal-region pairs, compare four local second-difference color costs in each diagonal direction. Keep exact ties unchanged; otherwise connect the lower-cost diagonal.
diagonal_contacts.topology: Before replacing either orthogonal pixel, check the outside-facing 2 by 2 corner. Preserve a pixel whose two orthogonal neighbors share its region but whose diagonal neighbor differs. Out-of-bounds labels are -1.
diagonal_contacts.replacement: When both candidate pixels can change, compare their summed normalized BGRA distances to the selected diagonal's two pixels, preserving the original float32 stores and double arithmetic. Resolve ties using the original comparison order.
diagonal_contacts.statistics: Write the selected root identifier directly to the chosen pixel. Do not update region counts or sums during repair; the next connected rebuild owns those updates.
diagonal_contacts.reference: Original 0x489a50, 0x489870, 0x489790, 0x47eab0, and 0x47e920; assembly supplies arithmetic and edge rules.

ownership: Public operations preserve caller inputs and own their working storage. Public boundaries validate once; recursive and arithmetic internals trust those validated inputs.
full_pipeline: The known-settings reference corpus is described in the private investigation archive's engine-reference-contract.json. The implemented segmentation branch does not establish complete image-output parity.

region_pass.api: createRegionOptimizer({ width, height, bgra, regions, finalLambda, minimumPixels }) returns owned optimizer state. iterate({ lambda, mode }) advances one pass; labels() returns owned projected indices; snapshot() returns owned indices, counts, sums, colorIndices, and activeCount. rebuild() recomputes connected regions and float32 statistics. projectPalette() assigns quantized unique colors to dense nonempty regions.
region_pass.input: Initial labels are nonnegative int32 values. Regions are rebuilt into four-connected components in first row-major encounter order. All settings are explicit.
region_pass.statistics: Accumulate normalized float32 BGRA sums in row-major pixel order after connected labeling. Keep int32 counts and union parents. Moving a pixel adds its normalized channels to the destination and subtracts them from the source with float32 rounding. Preserve residual sums of empty moved-from records until rebuild.
region_pass.scan: Scan pixels row-major. axis checks right then down. eight checks right, down, left, up, down-left, up-right, up-left, down-right. small checks right then down and merges when either region is below minimumPixels. An explicit pass minimumPixels overrides the constructor setting for that pass, matching the diagonal branch's temporary zero minimum.
region_pass.decisions: For axis/eight, merge when color cost < current lambda, or current lambda equals finalLambda and either count is below minimumPixels. Otherwise compare each boundary pixel with float32 byte-space region means; move the current pixel first if that strictly improves its error, otherwise test the neighbor pixel.
region_pass.union: The current pixel region absorbs the neighbor region. Resolve roots after each changed pair. Do not compact empty region slots until explicit rebuild.
region_pass.reference: Original 0x48ae30, 0x4ab3c0, 0x4aafd0, 0x4aab90, 0x4aaea0, and 0x47fcb0 with original statistic objects and unpatched instructions.
region_pass.limits: One unweighted pass with size-penalty weight zero. Complete scheduling, palette projection, and diagonal-contact repair are implemented below. Automatic anti-alias processing has a separate integrated branch below.

unweighted_segmentation.api: segmentUnweighted({ width, height, bgra, parameters }) returns owned indices, counts, normalized palette, and per-region colorIndices. parameters are numeric fields produced by resolveParameters.
unweighted_segmentation.scope: The unweighted branch with size-penalty weight zero. Diagonal extraction follows the additional schedule and palette rules below. segmentUnweighted requires anti-aliasing disabled; segment selects the separate anti-alias branch. Nonzero size penalties fail explicitly while unfinished.
unweighted_segmentation.initialization: Initialize recursive tiles using lambda_pre, then rebuild connected statistics.
unweighted_segmentation.schedule: Start at float32(lambda_initial). Compute a float32 exp(log(double(lambda_final)/double(lambda_initial))/(max_iterations*double(float32(rise_fraction)))) multiplier. After each pass, multiply in float32 and clamp to lambda_final when strictly greater.
unweighted_segmentation.iteration: Run max_iterations axis passes; rebuild connected statistics after every num_iter_btwn_renum passes. With diagonal extraction enabled, use a temporary minimumPixels of zero for those passes and one following eight-neighbor pass, then repair diagonal contacts. Rebuild, then apply and rebuild the minimum-region pass using the original minimumPixels when positive.
unweighted_segmentation.palette: Assign each region its float32 mean, quantize channels with native double multiply/add and byte truncation, and deduplicate exact BGRA bytes in first-region encounter order. Preserve color identifiers through the final minimum-region cleanup and connected rebuild.
unweighted_segmentation.diagonal_palette: Scale each region's float32 sums by float32(255 / float32(count)), truncate each resulting float32 channel to a byte without a rounding bias, and deduplicate BGRA bytes in first-region order. The constructor's internal reassignment threshold starts at -10; nonnegative squared errors cannot select a large-region replacement. Rewrite pixel labels to palette identifiers and rebuild connected regions, retaining palette identifiers through subsequent minimum-region cleanup.
unweighted_segmentation.diagonal_palette_api: Optimizer projectPalette({ diagonalExtraction: true }) uses this extraction and connected rebuild. projectPalette() uses the ordinary rounded-mean projection.
unweighted_segmentation.limits: Exact bounded comparisons for the two unweighted branches do not establish anti-alias segmentation or full vectorization parity.

presegmentation.api: presegmentRegions({ width, height, bgra, parameters }) returns owned indices, counts, sums, colorIndices, and activeCount before palette extraction.
presegmentation.scope: Original 0x4ab730(0), supporting unweighted and anti-alias profiles with size-penalty weight zero. Always use axis passes and the actual minimum-region setting, regardless of the later diagonal-extraction flag. Rebuild periodically, rebuild at the end, and apply the final minimum-region pass when positive. No palette projection or anti-alias optimization occurs here.
presegmentation.reference: Original 0x4aab30, 0x4ab730(0), 0x48ae30, and 0x48abe0. Capture base-region labels and all ordinary moments before the subsequent subpixel initializer.

anti_alias_segmentation.api: segment({ width, height, bgra, parameters }) selects the original unweighted or automatic anti-alias branch from Shared::is_anti_aliased. The anti-alias branch starts from prepared pixels and returns the same indices/counts/palette/colorIndices shape as unweighted segmentation.
anti_alias_segmentation.scope: Prepared automatic anti-alias segmentation with explicit native switches. Optional boolean clusterColors and shadowing select the standalone prepared component branches; omission selects their disabled states, not the actual native fresh constructor. Enabled shadowing requires explicit int32 shadowControl from the image workflow. Native constructor recordings explicitly supply both switches true. Numeric size-penalty weight remains zero.
anti_alias_segmentation.stages: Run true presegmentation and one canonical subpixel optimizer. With shadowing enabled, perform the original first color selection/transfer when required, recover fresh eight-neighbor shadow features while retaining cached costs, run exact detection/refinement/acceptance/restoration, then perform the original second color selection/projection. Quantize/deduplicate automatic palettes, rebuild connected labels, and apply final minimum-region cleanup. Supplied palettes retain their original identifiers and floats.
anti_alias_segmentation.palette_transfer: Quantize each final subpixel model color channel using double(value*255+0.5), truncate to its byte value, and deduplicate exact BGRA bytes in first-region encounter order. Normalize stored palette bytes with float32 1/255. Replace region labels with palette identifiers, rebuild four-connected components in row-major order, and retain each component's palette identifier.
anti_alias_segmentation.reference: Original 0x488d20 default anti-alias dispatch, 0x489de0, 0x48c050, 0x48b160, 0x4ab710, and final region assembly. Image decoding/filtering, nonzero size penalties, and full vectorization remain separate unfinished stages.

shadow_integration.switch: Explicit optional parameters.shadowing boolean maps the unregistered core 0x214 switch. Omission selects the prepared no-shadow branch already verified separately; the native fresh constructor supplies true explicitly. This is an original processing branch, not a compatibility bridge.
shadow_integration.control: Enabled shadowing requires explicit int32 parameters.shadowControl, captured at core 0x298 (Shared +0x90), separate from registered Shared::image_type_code at core 0x21c. Preserve the exact native integer; do not infer this field from the serialized image-type code.
shadow_integration.pipeline: One canonical segmentation path: base regions, native-equivalent subpixel optimization, first color selection/transfer when required, fresh eight-neighbor shadow preparation retaining existing cached costs, independent blur/gradients and all 42 features, detection, original reassignment/energy/acceptance/restoration, second color selection/projection, final palette transfer and cleanup. The public optimizeSubpixel stage remains separate and excludes shadowing, as its original 0x4a9ac0 routine does.
shadow_integration.initial_convergence_state: The original first PCA scalar is uninitialized. Canonical zero state reproduces all 2006 recorded feature/direction/flag outputs and all complete results in the current 72/578 prepared corpora. Explicit scalar kernel tests remain strict against actual native trace values. These observations are bounded evidence, not a claim of original zero initialization or proof for every possible allocator state.
shadow_integration.verification: Extend original constructor context recording to preserve the shadow switch and exact acceptance control. Keep every existing expected region map and moment assertion unchanged. All complete original response payload bytes must still equal operation 66 after stripping context bytes. Full image-file conversion is not yet established.
shadow_integration.status: All 72 complete constructor maps/moment bytes and 578 broader complete automatic/supplied segmentation results match the original. The initial alpha/blur and twenty-feature prepared classifier are separately verified.
shadow_integration.broader_reference_plan: Operations 82/83 supply already prepared BGRA directly to both the native byte raster and its Q8 cached image, mark that cache prepared without rerunning filters, write all 100 numeric parameters, explicit shadow/cluster switches and acceptance control, and capture complete segmentation results plus actual acceptance calls. Two fresh complete responses and traces must repeat exactly; traced and untraced outputs must be identical.

supplied_palette_segmentation.api: segment({ width, height, bgra, parameters, palette }) selects supplied-palette mode when palette is present. Supply normalized BGRA channels; retain their float32 values, order, duplicates and unused entries.
supplied_palette_segmentation.plain: Original 0x48dbe0 nearest assignment, connected rebuild, repeated nearest assignment, 0x489a50 diagonal repair, 0x489300 palette identifier marking, connected rebuild and final minimum-region cleanup. Diagonal repair runs regardless of the automatic diagonal-extraction flag.
supplied_palette_segmentation.anti_alias: Run true presegmentation and the complete subpixel optimizer. When shadowing is enabled, first project onto the supplied palette without the automatic first color-selection pass, transfer identifiers, then prepare/refine/accept shadows. Finally run color selection and projection with minimumInteriorPixels zero, transfer identifiers, rebuild components and perform final minimum-region cleanup. Supplied floats, order, duplicate and unused entries survive.
supplied_palette_segmentation.scope: Prepared pixels with size-penalty weight zero. Both shadow-disabled and explicitly enabled dispatch are implemented; the original 782-result corpus and the broader 578-result shadow/control corpus cover these paths separately.
supplied_palette_segmentation.native_precondition: Plain dispatch allocates statistics for the initial connected components, then 0x489300 writes one record per supplied palette entry. A native access violation occurred with a 1x1 image and three palette entries. A native preflight records 482 corpus inputs where the allocated statistic capacity is smaller than the palette count; these are retained separately and excluded from parity assertions. Independent connected rebuilding safely handles these inputs, but there is no successful native final result to compare. Do not claim full parity for this undefined native branch.

pipeline_segmentation_parity.scope: Independent labels, counts, palette floats and region color identifiers match prepared-pixel segmentation inside all 15 known-settings original pipelines. Later vector stages remain unfinished.

internal_moments: segmentWithMoments returns the same canonical state plus owned sums already computed by the optimizer. Prepared type/quality analysis reuses these moments. Public segment/segmentUnweighted retain their original four-field output shape; no second statistic pass or legacy input path is introduced.
